calculationBasis: Per-serving ingredient-sum estimate: sum(GI × available carbohydrate per serving)/100. Fineli Rel20 is the primary available-carbohydrate source; AFCD Release 3 fills only two missing Fineli foods (chickpea flour and tamarind paste). Published exact GI values, explicit analogues, and Table 1 category means may be used with source, match type, and confidence disclosed. Ingredients below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving are omitted. Not a measured mixed-meal response.
fineliEvidence: docs/nutrition/fineli-release-20-reference.json; only required records are copied into docs/nutrition/food-records.json. Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), Fineli Rel20, CC BY 4.0.

selectionNotes.selectionBasis: New recipes were selected from the highest current recipe-level available-carbohydrate estimates outside the first cohort; every selected recipe is recalculated from its ingredient-level Fineli amounts.
replacements: Massaman curry is included as the 21st calculated estimate with a documented curry-paste carbohydrate scenario range; eggplant and minced-beef casserole remains in the cohort.
Beef liver casserole remains without a published GL total because the earlier 3.45 estimate used an unmeasured zero-GI assumption for liver carbohydrates.
selectionNotes.massamanAdded: Massaman was the 21st estimate when originally added; the current pilot now includes 41 recipes after this 20-recipe extension.
selectionNotes.excludedPublication: Beef liver casserole remains without a published total: the prior 3.45 estimate assigned an unmeasured GI of zero to liver carbohydrates.
selectionNotes.newCohort: Twenty new recipes were chosen from the highest current available-carbohydrate estimates outside the existing 21. Selection rankings are not GK results; every estimate is recalculated from recipe ingredient amounts.
selectionNotes.ingredientSources: Fineli Rel20 remains the primary available-carbohydrate source. AFCD Release 3 supplies only chickpea flour and tamarind paste where Fineli had no matching item.
selectionNotes.newBatch: Six further recipes were added because matching ingredient-level Fineli/AFCD calculation records were available. Fourteen other high-ranking candidates remain for later batches until ingredient mappings, masses and preparation details are checked. Existing recipe-level carbohydrate estimates were used only to rank candidates; each GL result is recalculated ingredient by ingredient.

additionalCarbohydrateEvidence: AFCD Release 3 was used only for chickpea flour in vada pav and pure tamarind paste in pani puri because no matching Fineli foods were found. Source: Food Standards Australia New Zealand, Australian Food Composition Database Release 3, CC BY-SA 3.0 Australia. Values with and without sugar alcohols were equal for both items. This batch also uses AFCD Release 3 items identified by source IDs in the input records where matching Fineli foods were unavailable.
